items.title: Ramsey Lewis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: shows, as it is now with Charles Osgood.

ctx.x: It was in November of ’97. It was a while ago.

Yeah. I’m trying to separate now from others, but I can’t bring the actual performance to mind, because I keep mixing it with those other – with the ones on Bravo, and then the ones we did after that. That particular event – I know I was very, very impressed and honored that he called, asked me to do it, because at the time it was Charles Kuralt, and Sunday Morning with Charles Kuralt had become one of my favorite t.v. shows, as it is now with Charles Osgood. It’s still one of my favorite shows. I knew for a long…
Some of your other entrepreneurial ventures: Mapenzi Recording Company? Is that something we can talk about.
